content: Iesu Aiwab Ba au Jerusalem Irui
Osi sinat Jerusalem aurin sibiufin nan mafam gagamis Bethage a Bethany bisisi ato sinat Olive Oyauai nan. Iesu an baigibubunuotis ruam ainau iyafares sinai.

On iyaubaiyates iyau: “Omi wonan nan mafam tani namui yen. Omi wonan nan wongat mom on arimon foro donkey kafakakai nan wengarai siyous etatawar on wongaturai ato on foro min men tefanai sigai simair sibonanaboai on. On foro uram wonrufan ato nin wonboai wonnat.
Ato orot tani nan initetemim inau, omi aibo mes on bobo nanaba wofofour, ato omi wonawur wonau, Bada egogoi ato arimon ra kaita iniyafarai inmatabir men.”
On mes osi sinai ato foro donkey kafakakai etai nan sigaturai, goa metewan awanai nan uramai siyous itatawar. Osi uram sirurufan ato,
sabu fani nan sitatawar on sitetemis siyau, “Omi aifan wobiyamai ato foro donkey kafakakai worurufan?”
Osi on Iesu dura mamaba i’yawures on nanaba siyafotes ato sabu sikirires sinai.
Osi foro donkey kafakakain boboun sibo sinat Iesu aurin, asi beber on bobaitu kounai sirebegagaien ato Iesu igai foro tefanai imair.
Sabu sigaraba asi beber siboen etai nan siyabaren, sabu fani wengar rorous regai nan siyasutuenen ato etai siyabaren.
Sabu fani ainau Iesu nanai si’nan a sabu fani gibunai si’nat on sibosuruf sibiyoku si’yau, “God tanifain! God imomoginai on Bada Wabinai enat!
Ot tamat aiwab David an baiaiwab enat on God imomoginai! God tanifain!”
Iesu au Jerusalem irui, On inai tafaror goa amonai sawar engon tutufin inateteyen, baise awa ifofom on mes Iesu an baigibubunuotis auyotoat sasagis ruam mat sigat sinai au Bethany.
Iesu Bubudau Iyaudabai Irabob
Ra itom Iesu an baigibubunuotis mat Bethany emon simatabir si’nat ato Iesu bitanan igi.
On nanenei nan iyeit bubudau roroun auman it itatawar, on mes On inai auwatin ititai on wengar on er uwan auman ai ambin. On inat aurin aurin ato roroun wat it, yabin uwan an wera on men ibo on.
Iesu on bubudau aurin iyau, “Men iyafan tani arimon om wengar emon uwam inboai inan men.” Ato Iesu an baigibubunuotis min sitatam.
Iesu Inai au Tafaror Goa

Osi sinat au Jerusalem weie Iesu inai au tafaror goa ato osi sabu fani nan sibitotobon on ibosuruf ifaitanis sigat. Sabu tafanam touman asi agim sebigagaram bonen yangan on asi kema ikitabiren a sabu fani kiwiu kumag sibitotobon on asi sifumama ikitabiren,
mat On sabu isofafaris men sawar sitabaren goa amonai sitar sitrabon rebanai nan sitgat.

Namon On sabu ibebeyes iyau: “God an dura buk amonai sigayam, God iyau, ‘Yau au tafaror goa on arimon sinyorai bayoi an goa nin tafanamai sabu engon tutufin auris.’ Baise omi wobo woikitabirai on sabu bainauotis asi ob efan mes imatar!”

Priest aiwabis a Baifafaro an baibebeotis on ato dura Iesu ibikakafun sitatam, on mes osi sibosuruf eta fani sinunuen sitasubun mes. Osi Iesu aurin siber yabin sabu kuayo gagamin engon On an baibebe aurin on siduduran.
Ibirabirabi ato Iesu an baigibubunuotis mat mafam gagamin sikirir sinai.
Bubudau Wengar on Iniyoboet
Ra itom fomenei osi etai sibib si’nan ato siyeit bubudau sit. Wengar min imau isur aweroron mat ibo.
Peter inos bobo aifan imamatar on, ato on Iesu iyawur iyau, “Baibebeotim eite, Om bubudau uyaudabai min ato irabob!”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Omi God wonitutumai.

Yau awurem dura bag, iyai iyafan atonio oyau inawur inau, ‘Emisir toum eboem kamitai eitawarim.’ Om nunuamui on men fetag fetag uninonot mes, baise om unitutum on ato dura aifan u’yau on arimon inmatar, arimon aurim sinafour.
On yabinai awurem: Omi wonbayoi On aurin wonifefeyan, On wonitutumai on arimon wonboai ato ami gogoi aifan aurin wonbifefeyan on arimon initem.
Ato wonmisir wonbabayoi on, omi ami komasin turam aurin woiyamai yen on wonnotburai ato Tamam safamai on arimon omi ami bokomas wofofour on innotburem.”
Iesu An Baibad aurin Sitetem
Osi simatabir sinat men au Jerusalem. Iesu tafaror goa amonai ibibib ato priest aiwabis, Baifafaro an baibebeotis, a sabu kawian on sinat aurin,
ato sitetemai siyau, “Om baibad on iyafan item atonio osi bobo efofour i?”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Yau au baitetem kaitamom wat on anitetemim, ato omi wonbiyafoteu on Yau arimon ankasonem au baibad mamaba abo atonio osi bobo afofour.
Omi wonkasoneu, John Bapataito’otin an baibad on men emon ibo sabu ibibapataitois: On God emon ibo o orot emon ibo?”
Osi sibosuruf tous wat sanasi sigagamois si’yau, “Ot mamaba tanau? Ot ari taniyafotai tanau, ‘On God emon ibo’ ato On arimon inau, ‘Ato omi aibo mes men John Bapataito’otin woitutumai on?’
Baise ot ari tanau, ‘On orot emon...’” (Osi sabu auris siber, yabin sabu engon tutufin situtum John Bapataito’otin on aubairuruotin.)
On mes osi Iesu siyafotai siyau, “Wei men wasagob.” Iesu iyawures iyau, “Yau mat men ankasonem iyafan baibad iteu on atonio osi bobo afofour.”
